coordinates: all 6 torque/speed pairs in the same declared load-side Nm and rad/s coordinate, sign/reduction/electrical current convention explicitly bound
default_binding: all-zero/unbound => invalid; no hardware coefficient or limit supplied
Kload_lower_Nm_per_A: positive lower bound valid for all declared quadrants/current/voltage/temperature/speed domains
Cbus_loss_upper_W_per_A2: nonnegative caller-certified BUS-REFERRED effective quadratic-loss upper coefficient, covers copper and omitted electrical path loss; NOT bare winding R
eta_drive_lower: positive <=1 conversion lower bound for positive mechanical term over declared domain
eta_regen_upper: 0..1 regenerative conversion upper bound over declared domain
electronics_other_upper_W: nonnegative caller upper bound for losses not covered by the two other terms, including stall/braking domain
calibration_domain: explicit evidence id, valid-from/until, four-quadrant masks, current maxima, load-speed maxima, bus voltage domain, per-axis temperature domain; all unbound unless caller supplies evidence
live_frame: valid flag, matching calibration evidence and load-coordinate id, reserve qualification and source flags; reachable speed intervals, bus voltage interval, temperature intervals, signed-DC boxes and budget sources carry timestamps/valid-until; box/drive frame ids coherent
bus_current_upper_A: respective positive/charge power upper divided by positive fresh Vlo
constraints: positive power, charge power, discharge bus current, charge bus current, each axis current, signed-DC torque box; zero tolerance
reserve: explicit caller tau0, no default zero; infeasible invalid, arithmetic-overlap UNCERTIFIED invalid; no shrinking reserve
request: explicit caller tau1 already in same qualified signed-DC box; otherwise typed/domain failure, no hidden clamp
search: certified endpoint or exactly 40 convex-segment bisections; lower endpoint accepted, upper endpoint not-certified only
representation: binary64 interior tuple encloses exact affine segment plus rounded tuple; final certificate and final clock poll before accepted output
clock: caller monotonic available uint64 ns, external cycle start and positive budget, cooperative polls including final commit; no return-to-driver/WCET guarantee
fault_payload: valid=0,s=0,tau6=0; never use invalid zeros as a fallback in overspeed box
fault_latch: structural/nonfinite/alias/stale/clock/numeric errors latch until explicit init; ordinary deadline or reserve budget/uncertainty failure does not claim permanent hardware fault
placement: actual driver-rate load-side torque after any inversePD/D4/gain transformations; not a 100Hz pre-scaler protection claim
qualification_excluded: no calibration evidence invented; no electrical/thermal/battery/HIL/board/CAN/stability/C3 enqueue/WCET qualification
